messages:
maya: Heads-up: ran the new local sampleapp with --deterministic-retries and saw duplicate DB writes (same charge id) during a small load run.
jorge: can you paste logs?
maya: snippet:
```
2026-03-28T11:12:01.001Z WARN retry: request=charge_77 status=429 attempt=1 backoff_ms=0
2026-03-28T11:12:01.002Z INFO sender: POST /webhook charge_77 idempotency=missing
2026-03-28T11:12:01.203Z INFO sender: POST /webhook charge_77 idempotency=missing
```
maya: two POSTs ~200ms apart. backoff=0 because the flag sets jitter=0 to make traces reproducible for debugging.
kevin: oh no. sdk parity check: does node/python/csharp behave the same?
jorge: python SDK attaches Idempotency-Key by default; node and go sampleapps opt out when deterministic mode is on to reduce log noise. that's the root cause.
sdk-bot: note: deterministic-retries intended for single-process dev only. docs currently say this but it's easy to miss when running docker-compose or CI.
kevin: fix suggestions: 1) never disable automatic Idempotency-Key insertion when deterministic mode is enabled (only honor explicit opt-out); 2) keep a tiny jitter floor (2-4ms) even in deterministic runs to avoid multi-process herd; 3) seed RNG with high entropy per-process (pid+crypto) so multiple containers don't correlate.
jorge: also add a sampleapp flag --preserve-jitter and change compose/helm defaults to keep safe replay enabled (USE_SAFE_REPLAY=true).
maya: agree. add an e2e: spin up 6 replica sampleapps in CI and run thundering-herd sim nightly to catch regressions.
ops: created ticket INF-2910: "deterministic retries + disabled idempotency => duplicate side-effects" assigned to @jorge.
ci-bot: PR 4368 opened by jorge: node-sdk: always attach Idempotency-Key unless --no-idempotency; RNG reseed; tiny jitter floor. Running CI.
kevin: also update onboarding docs and the quickstart to warn: "Do not enable deterministic retries in multi-process or CI environments; use --preserve-jitter instead."
maya: action items: jorge -> PR + CI test; kevin -> docs + sampleapp defaults; maya -> add repro script and staging smoke test.
ci-bot: PR 4368 merged to staging. All checks passed.
maya: marking this as mitigated, will monitor staged runs overnight. if duplicates reappear we'll rollback the flag.
